description: Source code for UE creation procedure in a 5G network DU (Distributed Unit), including context creation, resource setup, RLC/SDU layer setup, MAC UE creation, and F1AP signaling.

classes.name: ue_creation_procedure
classes.description: Class handling the procedure for creating a UE in the DU, including context setup, resource allocation, signaling, and cleanup.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine executing the UE creation steps sequentially, including context creation, resource setup, signaling, and cleanup on failure.

methods.name: create_du_ue_context
methods.description: Creates and registers a new DU UE context based on the request parameters.

methods.name: clear_ue
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the UE context and associated resources.

methods.name: setup_du_ue_resources
methods.description: Sets up PCell PHY/MAC resources and SRB1 for the UE.

methods.name: create_rlc_srbs
methods.description: Creates RLC entities for SRB0 and SRB1.

methods.name: create_mac_ue
methods.description: Sends request to MAC layer to create a new UE context.

methods.name: create_f1ap_ue
methods.description: Creates F1AP message for UE creation signaling.

methods.name: connect_layer_bearers
methods.description: Connects bearers between F1AP, RLC, and MAC layers.
